crew.notes: Not copied from any other pack. Verified per-ship.

sister_ships.source: ITW icon-of-the-seas.page.json related.sister_ships + Wikipedia See Also Star of the Seas
sister_ships.notes: Pack names both. A fourth Icon-class hull (TBN 2027/2028 pages exist on this site) is not claimed as in service.

godparent.value: Lionel Messi (Royal Caribbean styling: Icon of Icon / official Icon of the ship)
godparent.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Icon_of_the_Seas citing Royal Caribbean Press Center 23 Jan 2024 and the naming ceremony livestream
godparent.notes: Not a conventional godmother title. Pack says 'Lionel Messi named the ship' rather than inventing a godmother label.

location.value: Miami (ceremony in the AquaDome per contemporaneous reports)

selection_mechanism.value: Royal Caribbean partnership / Inter Miami association; not a public contest
selection_mechanism.notes: Press-center URL cited by Wikipedia. Pack does not narrate the soccer-ball-on-a-stand mechanic.

route.notes: Same product family as this generic pack. Pack states that; it does not invent the 2024 day-by-day.

auto_gratuity_rate.value: $18.50 USD/guest/day non-suite (including Junior Suites); $21.00 USD/guest/day suites. 18% on beverages/packages/specialty/room service/mini-bar; 20% spa/salon.
auto_gratuity_rate.notes: FAQ opened this session. 7-night totals $129.50 / $147.00 per person derived from those daily rates × 7. Pack tells the reader to reconfirm.

wine_alcohol_policy.value: One sealed 750 ml wine/champagne per drinking-age guest on embarkation day. Boxed wine prohibited. Extra/port/duty-free held until last day. Beer/spirits seized not returned. 12×17 oz non-alcoholic per stateroom.

corkage.value: $15 per bottle if personal wine/champagne is consumed in public areas

drink_package_name_and_pricing.value: Deluxe Beverage Package (dynamic pricing; all legal-age adults in a cabin must buy if one does). 18% gratuity on the package. Refreshment Package is the non-alcohol product.
drink_package_name_and_pricing.source: https://www.royalcaribbean.com/faq/questions/what-is-the-deluxe-beverage-package (session web search + pack hedge). Exact $/day NOT asserted in the pack.
drink_package_name_and_pricing.notes: Pack refuses a stale $/day figure and points at Cruise Planner + drink-calculator.html. CocoCay extension of beverage/Wi-Fi packages is Royal's published perk, also on the ITW CocoCay page.

laundry_availability.value: No self-service laundry onboard; washing/pressing/dry cleaning via stateroom attendant. Wash-and-fold bag special exists (price moves).
laundry_availability.notes: RCL FAQ opened this session: self-service laundry facilities are not provided onboard for safety. Pack bounded the claim to this 7-night sailing; the FAQ is fleet-wide.

app_naming.value: Royal Caribbean app (Royal iQ chat is inside it; no separate IQ app)
app_naming.source: Pack prose; consistent with current RCL app branding. Not a second-pack copy.

single_supplement.value: Often 200% of per-person double occupancy, with occasional solo promotions below that — check the actual fare
single_supplement.source: Pack hedge; no live fare fetched

ship_phone_relay.value: (888) 724-7447 US / (321) 953-9003 outside US; $7.95 USD/min Visa/MC; stateroom ship-to-shore same rate on SeaPass

philipsburg_water_taxi.notes: Site port page, not another pack.

maho_taxi.value: ~$20–25 per person, ~20 minutes from the pier

magens_bay.value: Entrance ~$5; loungers ~$15/day (2024 visit notes on the port page)

cococay_included_vs_paid.value: Included: Oasis Lagoon, Chill Island beaches, loungers/umbrellas/towels, BBQ, trams. Paid ranges as of 2025-12-26 review: Thrill Waterpark $50–65, balloon $40–50, Hideaway Beach $35–45, zipline $35–45, Coco Beach Club $90–120, cabanas hundreds–high hundreds.
cococay_included_vs_paid.source: ITW ports/cococay.html (price notice 2025-12-26; last reviewed February 2026)
cococay_included_vs_paid.notes: Pack flags these as moving. Distinguishes island Thrill Waterpark from shipboard Category 6.

worlds_largest_cruise_ship.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Icon_of_the_Seas (and List of largest cruise ships, cited there)

category_6_largest_waterpark_at_sea.claim: Thrill Island — Category 6 waterpark (six slides). Wikipedia: company claims tallest waterfall, tallest water slide, and largest waterpark of any cruise ship.
category_6_largest_waterpark_at_sea.disposition: softened-and-sourced — pack names Category 6 and six slides; does not repeat 'tallest waterfall' / 'tallest slide' marketing.

oasis_lagoon_largest_freshwater_pool_bah.claim: Oasis Lagoon described as the large freshwater pool (ITW CocoCay page: largest freshwater pool in the Bahamas — included)
oasis_lagoon_largest_freshwater_pool_bah.disposition: softened-and-sourced — pack says 'the large freshwater pool' rather than repeating the superlative.

hideaway_first_suspended_infinity_pool.claim: Wikipedia: Hideaway beach club featuring first suspended infinity pool of any ship
hideaway_first_suspended_infinity_pool.disposition: softened-and-sourced — pack says 'suspended infinity pool' without 'first of any ship'.

preship_review.A_physics_geography: GT not used as a stability promise (pack says large ≠ still). Eastern Caribbean two-sea-day geometry matches the long Miami–SXM run. Seasickness hedged. Accessibility: 'confirm with Guest Services' for rides not measured.
preship_review.A2_port_grounding: Every named port has an ITW page: port-miami, philipsburg, st-maarten, st-thomas, cococay. Slug variants checked. Distance words given numbers (Maho 20 min / $20–25; Magens $5; CocoCay 55 mi NW of Nassau). Tender: CocoCay docks; no other tender on this product. Berth named where it changes the day (Wathey Pier; Havensight vs Crown Bay).
preship_review.B_internal_consistency: 248,663 GT, 5,610/7,600, 2,350 crew, 20 decks, 364.75 m / 1,197 ft, $18.50/$21, $129.50/$147, $7.95/min, $15 corkage — grepped once each for conflicts. Day order matches emergency-card itinerary string and PWA. Two sea days at start + one after STT, not the Western Caribbean 1-sea-then-ports shape.
preship_review.C_voice: Honest limitation in Welcome. No first-person Icon sailing claim. Port pages' first-person (St. Thomas 2024, St. Maarten 2018–2024) attributed to the site pages, not this author. Crutch 'honest/honestly/genuinely': 0 after edit. Banned marketing vocab: 0. One triplet-of-absences ('no urgency, no upsell, no countdown'). Parallel port headers shaped by content (two-nation island / left-side driving / manufactured island), not a repeated template.
preship_review.D_register: No ICP/AEO/moat/funnel/cohort. 'Cruise Planner' is the passenger-facing RCL name.
preship_review.E_time_sensitivity: Prices verified 2026-09-03 called out in At a Glance and Section 5. Gratuity sourced to live FAQ. Drink-package $/day refused. CocoCay add-on ranges dated to the port page review.
